checks.actual_retrieval_and_packing: Pipeline re-embeds each request, retrieves exactly 50 dense/hybrid candidates, observes only the first K literal query/source scores with selected B, orders by fresh raw logit difference/originalindex/id, and gives only that ranked prefix to the unchanged original packer. Baselines pack full 50. Original static dependency expansion,source/fullspan validation,8excerpt/12000char/4096token caps and timing boundary remain intact.
checks.decision_hash_binding: CLI freezes supplied decision-input bytes to project-relative SHA-256. run rechecks every binding before run-start/scoring. The setup-selection semantics remain protocol/root-auditor obligations, not inferred from the presence of arbitrary hashed files.
checks.failure_preservation: Resolved review blocker: driver previously overwrote helper failure.json,losing its detailed counters. Final driver preserves existing failure.json and completion.json, writing separate driver-failure.json when needed; exclusive destination check prevents another overwrite. CPU regression test confirms byte-equivalent detailed objects remain.
checks.freeze_schema: Root freezer recomputes source membership, raw source hashes, full-span evidence, inventory/settings, model metadata and runtime/source/package closure without loading model weights. Exact current frozen keys/values are rechecked before run; helper and supervisor source are included in bindings. Koa is explicitly observed development.
checks.parity_inputs: Each development repository uses its first positive query and saved dense 50 pool in manifest order; content lookup now uses pool window.source_hash. Literal pairs are frozen in the parity plan and rechecked before run. B1 scores are fresh, not old score substitution.
checks.parity_no_embedding: Parity only invokes the resident scorer; it never calls embedding weight verification, indexing or pipeline. The freeze constructor verifies embedding metadata only with _model=None. Completion records empty embedding counts; source geometry uses retained literal pairs.
checks.parity_numeric_and_ties: All metadata/input hashes must match across batch modes. Frozen finite yes/no logits,difference,binary signal limits are inclusive and independently checked. For index i<j, comparing delta>=0 incorporates original-index stable tie order, records ties becoming opposite order and inversions becoming exact ties. Strong inversions and top-five swaps beyond the fixed near-tie band fail.
checks.supervisor_ownership: New process sessions are owned explicitly; readiness binds planhash,PID/group,completed warmup and exact127.0.0.1port. Supervisor is bounded by readiness/whole-study deadlines,TERM 30 s/KILL 10 s grace,onlysignalsownedgroups,recordsfailure/interruption/forcedkill,cleansauth token and optionalownedcaffeinate. Private directory 700/files 600 and immutable start/final receipts are tested.
checks.synthetic_clipping: Four-line alpha/beta fixture avoids prior quadratic thousands-of-lines clipping. Actual pinned tokenizer/unchanged PairBuilder CPU check retained exactly two physical lines, 4605 tokens, SHA 7d3a2c6532c860948d0d4588a5b7cbc42a9cd34bf5dcd18888224f361914723c; no native runtime or weights imported.
checks.worker_ownership: Engine closure and model/weights ownership tuple are both released before clearing native allocator cache. Seven fake lifecycle cases verify warmups,normal stop,load/runtime/request failures,no unauthorized inference and closure release before allocator measurement. Stop records allocator peak and post-cleanup state,not OS RSS.
checks.worker_requests: Loopback-only authenticated score endpoint accepts exactlyrequest_id,pairs,batch_size; engine enforces literal query/source only. Seen request IDs prevent retries/cache replays. Failure freezes worker state and retained forward ledger/counters; supervisor/root forbid stage resume/overwrite.
